newsitem.title: USA: GPU not yet set restart for 610 MW NJ nuke.
newsitem.headline: GPU not yet set restart for 610 MW NJ nuke.

text.p: General Public Utilities Corp (GPU) said Monday it still had not set a restart date for the 610 megawatt (MW) Oyster Creek nuclear power plant, which was manually shut Friday.
"It was a problem with cooling water to the generator. The cooling water fluctuated," an onsite spokeswoman said.
The company would not be able set a startup time for Oyster Creek until repairs or adjustments to correct the cooling water flow were completed, she said.
The plant's reactor was operating at 100 percent power on its second day on line following a 49 day refueling outage when the fluctuation occurred.
GPU owns and operates Oyster Creek in Forked River, N.J.
